messages:
Maya (Finance): Quick postmortem follow-up from today's incident — delayed ingestion caused duplicate token counts that bubbled into invoices for a subset of customers. Root cause looks like overlapping retry windows + missing dedupe for partial batches. I distilled action items below.

Alex (SRE): thanks Maya. can we get owners + solid timelines? customers asking for ETA on corrections.

Maya (Finance): yes. high level plan: (1) stop bleed (prevent further duplicate counts) — immediate, (2) compute affected accounts + delta — 48h, (3) run corrective credits or invoice reissue — 72–120h depending on approvals, (4) longer-term guardrails + recurrence detection — 2 weeks. assigning owners now.

Rebecca (Billing): I can own invoice corrections + approvals. I'll prepare a credit batch template and a rollback plan. ETA to produce the template and list of impacted invoices: 36h. @Jia can you prepare a customer comms draft?

Jia (CS): on it. I'll have a short explainer + credit FAQ by EOD tomorrow. want to coordinate timing with billing.

Leo (DataEng): I'll own the "compute affected accounts" piece. plan: run a differential query against the ledger snapshot at T0 and current ingest to derive token deltas and a per-account credit amount. rough SQL:

```
SELECT account_id, SUM(token_delta) AS tokens_to_credit
FROM ledger_deltas
WHERE ingest_window BETWEEN '2026-03-15T02:00Z' AND '2026-03-15T08:00Z'
AND event_type IN ('retry','ingest')
GROUP BY account_id;
```

I'll hand off a CSV of accounts + suggested credit values to Rebecca within 36h.

Sam (Infra): I'll implement an emergency gate to reject duplicate retries for that pipeline today. short patch + config flip. target: within 6 hours. will post PR link once up.

Alex (SRE): I'll add recurrence detection to ops alerts: if token spikes with a retry pattern repeat within rolling 24h for same job, page owners and create a ticket automatically. ETA for initial rule: 48h.

Maya (Finance): Nice. Also two process items: (A) temporary manual hold for any invoice finalizations hitting the last 24h ingest window until delta compute completes, (B) weekly checkpoint doc for next 30 days to watch for any long-tail corrections. I will own the checkpoint doc and schedule.

IncidentBot: Incident #2026-03-15-07 acknowledged by oncall Alex. Status: investigating -> mitigation in progress.

Rebecca (Billing): note: for customers on committed contracts we may need legal signoff for reissue vs credit. I'll flag any accounts > $5k impact.

Maya (Finance): good flag. Rebecca, add a column to the CSV for "requires_legal_review".

Leo (DataEng): quick note — we found approx ~1.2M duplicated tokens across ~440 accounts in the initial sample. distribution is long-tail: 70% of tokens in top 20 accounts, many small accounts with single-digit token deltas. will surface full histogram in the CSV.

Jia (CS): to customer outreach — propose this cadence: immediate acknowledgement (sent), credit confirmation + expected invoice update (after Rebecca runs batch), follow-up check next billing cycle. I'll draft templates for each.

Sam (Infra): PR posted: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ingest/+/1234 — patch rejects retries that have identical idempotency_key and timestamp within 10s window. rolling to prod in 2x smaller batches. Monitoring added.

Alex (SRE): thanks Sam. once patch is live, let's run a synthetic load for the edge-case window to validate dedupe. I'll coordinate.

Maya (Finance): checkpoints:
- 6h: Sam deploys gate (owner: Sam)
- 36h: Leo provides CSV of affected accounts (owner: Leo)
- 48h: Rebecca prepares credit batch template + flags (owner: Rebecca)
- 72–120h: Billing runs credits / reissues invoices (owner: Rebecca & Maya)
- 2 weeks: recurrence detection + post-fix retrospective (owner: Alex & Leo)

Rebecca (Billing): I'll update the billing board with these timelines and create ticket BILL-8943.

Maya (Finance): I'll open a remediation tracking doc and invite owners. Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/finance/remediation/2026-03-15-longtail (draft).

Alex (SRE): one more ask — let's capture the deploy/version IDs that introduced the change to the retry behavior so we can link in the postmortem. Leo, can you include that in the CSV if available?

Leo (DataEng): yes — I can join logs with deploy metadata. adding columns: prod_git_sha, pipeline_job_id.

Jia (CS): customer comms draft ready for review: https://docs.internal/redwood/cs/comm-2026-03-15-dedupe. please leave comments.

Maya (Finance): thanks all. I'll schedule a 15m sync in 12 hours to confirm the 6h/36h checkpoints. If anything slips, call it out here and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:

Alex (SRE): acked.

Sam (Infra): gate live in staging, will promote to prod after a short soak (2h). posting updates. :rocket:

IncidentBot: Update: mitigation applied by Sam. Monitoring shows no new duplicate patterns in the last 30 minutes.

Rebecca (Billing): starting template prep now. will post SAMPLE_CREDIT_PAYOUT.csv when ready.

Leo (DataEng): CSV generated, uploading to secure folder. preview: 440 rows, columns [account_id, tokens_to_credit, amount_usd, requires_legal_review, prod_git_sha, pipeline_job_id].

Maya (Finance): great. closing the loop for now — we will reconvene after the 36h handoff. thanks everyone. :heart:
